mainEntity.name: At what age should a youth athlete start specialized training?

acceptedAnswer.text: The ideal age for a youth athlete to start specialized training can vary, but generally, foundational movement skills and body awareness can begin around ages 8-12. More intensive, sport-specific strength and conditioning usually becomes beneficial in early adolescence (12-14+), when growth plates are more developed. At Cave Training, we assess each athlete's physical maturity and athletic goals rather than strictly adhering to age cutoffs, ensuring training is safe and effective for their individual development stage. This prevents potential injuries and burnout often associated with starting too early or with inappropriate intensity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Foundational training can begin around 8-12, with more intense sport-specific conditioning beneficial in early adolescence (12-14+). Cave Training assesses individual physical maturity and goals for safe, effective training.
